ex-instant.label: Floating heights, instant switch (Mikhail's draft)
ex-instant.target_rule: Entry of the next height = the block whose votes complete the 2/3 quorum, fixed in that block; voters switch at their next unit.

ex-sticky.label: Floating heights, sticky voters (round-start state)
ex-sticky.target_rule: Same entry, fixed in the quorum block; voters keep the state seen at the round's first unit, so the entry is first voted in the next round.

round-target.label: Round-aligned target (Casper FFG, staggered votes)
round-target.target_rule: Checkpoint of round r = the head visible at the round's first unit (unit 23r); every round-r vote names it.

px-sticky.label: Prefix counting, round-aligned heights
px-sticky.target_rule: Each vote names the voter's head at vote time; round r justifies the deepest block with 2/3 of round r's votes at or after it, final at the round's last inclusion.

rf.label: Rolling FFG (δ = 1)
rf.target_rule: Every unit is a position; its target is the last block with slot < slot(unit) - δ (δ = 1).
